name: dca-craft
description: Craft skills and agents independent of the architecture style: Test-Driven Development, Clean Code while writing, Architecture Decision Records, end-user browser tests (Page Objects, stable selectors, setting up a browser runner), the Ubiquitous Language glossary and the strategic context map, and three review perspectives with the familiar names — review-ddd, review-hexagonal, review-clean-code — plus thin reviewer and E2E agents around them. An outside view: it reads what any project has — code, glossary, context map, AGENTS.md — and names no DCA artifact. Pairs with dca-core, which adds the DCA method.
